{{Top|leg}}
The '''Senate utility tunnels''' comprised an extensive 572-quadrant, bi-level tunnel system, built deep beneath the infrastructure, that delivered both ''water'' and ''air'' to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

The Senate air system was stacked on top of the water system, with linked passageways that allowed workers to commute between the two systems. Interactive orientation blueprints—laser-embossed schematics—of the Senate system could be found scattered throughout, upon walls, allowing workers to more easily access desired work areas and access points.

In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], the air-tunnels were to be used as a delivery system for the [[Zone of Self-Containment]] drug by the galactic criminal [[Granta Omega]] and mad scientist [[Jenna Zan Arbor]], as part of a plan to assassinate [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and ''thousands'' of Senators and their top advisors, but the plot was ultimately [[Attack on the Senate Building|foiled]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] (though not without casualties).

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Senate Utility Tunnels featured in the young adult novel ''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]'', the ninth volume in the [[Star Wars: Jedi Quest|''Jedi Quest'']] series written by [[Jude Watson]]. It has been the only appearance of the tunnels to date.
